title: contacts/calendars servers: validate Media and Link blobId as an Id in create/update
description: Found during JMAP-tna1.9. RFC 9610 §2 types the Media 'blobId' as Id, but ContactCard/set stores any string: a create with media.p.blobId '#nope' (not a valid Id, RFC 8620 §1.2) is created and read back unchanged. The same likely holds for the blob's existence. Decide: invalidProperties naming 'media' (or the path) for a malformed blobId; whether to check existence via a backend hook (spec-method-defaults: no no-op default). Then update crate-jmap-contacts-server/tests/blob_creation_refs.rs unknown_blob_ref_is_left_unchanged, which pins today's behaviour.
notes: Also calendars-server: CalendarEvent/set stores a Link blobId '#nope' (top-level links and nested locations/*/links) though draft-ietf-jmap-calendars §5.3 / JSCalendar Link blobId is Id; crate-jmap-calendars-server/tests/blob_creation_refs.rs unknown_link_blob_ref_is_left_unchanged pins today's behaviour.
